matches.quote: Equation (1) and the DFT comparison assume an intrinsic Berry-curvature mechanism, but no scaling analysis is presented... plot σAHE against σxx (and ρAHE against M)
The symmetry argument that the CRO-induced monoclinic distortion is needed to activate the IP-AHE conflicts with bulk Pbnm symmetry... state which σ_ij components each case allows
the quoted 7×7×7 mesh is for the band structure rather than the Berry-curvature integral... show the sensitivity of σDFT to... k-mesh convergence
and the calculation is for bulk LCMO without the CRO layers or interfaces.
β_LC − 90° ranges from 0.03 to 0.2°... computed as a "layer-averaged" quantity from d_OR extracted from RSMs... Yet the text says the tilting is "even visible directly..."
measure an in-plane Hall control on a CRO-only film; measure CRO/LCMO bilayers... and an LCMO film with a non-magnetic, weak-SOC or insulating buffer that imposes similar octahedral tilts
The gating experiment does not establish that IP-AHE is switched through a structural change in LCMO... No measurement of β_LC or of the LCMO octahedral tilts after gating
It is not stated whether ρxy was antisymmetrized in H (or M) to remove ρxx and planar-Hall admixtures from contact misalignment, or only linearly background-subtracted.
confirm whether the LCMO is protonated at 1.4 V and where the protons sit (e.g. SIMS depth profile, or neutron reflectometry)
In this regime M_z is linear in H, so the AHE ∝ M_z is also linear, and "subtracting the linear component" removes it
U = 8 eV, J = 2 eV on Mn 3d is unusually large and untested; ... show the sensitivity of σDFT to U (for example 3–8 eV)
The calculated σ is already 4 S/cm at β_LC = 90.00° and rises only by a factor of two up to 90.16°
measure a t_LCMO series at fixed tCRO to test whether σAHE scales as a bulk or an interface quantity

notes: C2 is marked partly because P4/P8 propose controls (single-layer LCMO, bilayers, non-magnetic/insulating buffers) while showing bulk Pbnm in (110)O orientation already breaks the relevant mirror under M||[-110]O. C10 is marked partly because P18/P4 critique inferring the monoclinic tilt from RSM d_OR and overstating STEM/GPA resolution rather than asking for a direct P21/m space-group determination. C13 is marked partly because P12 questions the DFT trend across beta_LC on parameter-isolation and convergence grounds rather than noting nonzero cubic AHC away from E_F.
